sentences.en: She broke off her engagement in a fit of anger.
sentences.zh: 她在一阵愤怒中解除了婚约。

sentences.en: I can't accept the invitation because I have another engagement.
sentences.zh: 我不能接受邀请因为我已经有别的约定。

sentences.en: She doesn't want him to buy an expensive engagement ring.
sentences.zh: 她不想让他买一枚昂贵的订婚戒指。

senses.zh: 婚约；约会；交战；诺言；进场（游戏术语）
